# Four published LEAP summaries

Run `python tools/evidence_program/read_leap_aggregates.py tools/evidence_program/tests/fixtures/forecast-surveys` from the repository root. This reads only the fixed ledger and manifest filenames, with bounded bytes/structure and no network calls.

The fixture is a CC BY 4.0 manually curated selection, not original HTML or a general scraper. See [NOTICE](NOTICE.md). Only Wave 12, unconditional AI-caused catastrophe by 31 December 2050 and the four exact publisher groups are supported. “Unconditional” includes expected future policies. Status quo, P1–P5, sub-catastrophic harm and extinction are different items.

The stable question and group identity is distinct from a reviewed instrument-definition digest, original source-page revision and derivative-ledger revision. An unchanged input gives unchanged result IDs. Source/derivative changes create new result versions; changed instrument wording fails closed until explicit review updates its digest. The reader does not overwrite history or write any records to a database.
